prespecified_behavior_summary.interpretation: Descriptive equal-weight mean across the first6 prespecified source draws, retaining identical logical models; not an estimate from all512 source draws.

dataset.source_sampling: Each draw independently samples16 distinct patterns without replacement from the fixed eligible pool. Sizes1/2/4/8/16 are prefixes within a draw; overlap across independent draws is allowed.
dataset.exclusion_limit: H3g512 and all H3i union patterns are excluded. Earlier full-universe studies used all N12 patterns, making never-seen-pattern exclusion impossible; no such novelty claim is made.
dataset.behavior_selection: Exactly the first6 source draw seeds at sizes1 and8, all12 logical models, regardless of success/failure. Three search seeds per distinct solver energy with explicit identity mappings.
dataset.target_distribution: Uniform unique valid1/2/3clue N13 inputs excluding H3j evaluation inputs. Target labels are evaluation-only.

calibration.explanation: q and its symbolic delta=q-1,tau=-q(q-1)/2 are declared structural priors. Every target arm shares the inherited N12 offset128 mean-absolute-field unit. No target fit or label calibration.

output_diagnostics.counterfactual_scope: Rescore identical stopped boards under the supplied target oracle; this removes false exclusions and restores missed ones, without rerunning search.

limits: The fixed primitive-line family and coordinate geometry are strong supplied priors. This is not geometry-free discovery.
Source-bank variation is the unit of the primary512-draw inference; search seeds are separate repeated inference draws.
The source population excludes previous restricted H3g/H3i banks, but older full-universe studies prevent never-seen mathematical pattern claims.
Behavior uses the first6 draws only at sizes1/8; no population-wide N13 accuracy estimate is claimed from this subset.
Target cardinality, temperature unit, count-energy design, q gate and certificate-first selection remain fixed from H3j. No N13 training or recalibration.
